'''Skysnare''' were large avians native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]].

==Description==
Native to the mountain tops of Auratera, the skysnares were large birds that were naturally camouflaged by their blue and white plumage. Equipped with four powerful talons and a long hooked beak, the Skysnare had two eyes on the top of its head and two on the bottom. Skysnares that lived near to the ruins of [[Acablas/Legends|Acablas]] possessed slight [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], allowing them not only to sense prey, but to pull prey up into the air with the Force and catch it in its huge beak.<ref name="NoP" />
